A massive Brown with a modjob for a nose stops us.
We wait for the metal nose to snort and sniff.
He’s bigger than Dancer.

paragraphs.source_en: “Dye in his hair,” he growls at me, taking a whiff of my hair. “A Ruster, this one be.”
